At the June 2024 FOMC meeting (June 11-12, happening at the cutoff date), the dot plot shifted from 3 expected 2024 cuts to just 1, with markets pricing September — not July — as the "live" meeting. The Fed had not telegraphed a July cut through its forward guidance, and the structural late-plateau phase (11 months holding at 5.25-5.50%) meant the meeting was a hold.
